# pangolin_redirect (Resource)

Redirects requests to another host, either for paths on an existing resource (`resource_id`) or for a domain of its own (`domain_id`). Requires Pangolin 1.25 or later. Permanent redirects also need Badger 1.8.0 or later. Import using the format `<org_id>:<redirect_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_redirect.example acme:5`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send a path on an existing resource to another host.
resource "pangolin_redirect" "docs" {
  org_id            = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  name              = "docs"
  resource_id       = pangolin_resource.example.resource_id
  destination_host  = "https://docs.example.org"
  path_match_type   = "prefix"
  match_path        = "/docs"
  rewrite_path_type = "stripPrefix"
}

# Redirect a whole domain.
resource "pangolin_redirect" "old_site" {
  org_id           = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  name             = "old-site"
  domain_id        = pangolin_domain.example.domain_id
  subdomain        = "old"
  destination_host = "https://www.example.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_host` (String) Where requests go, as `scheme://host[:port]` with no path, e.g. `https://example.com`. The request path, after any rewrite, is appended to it.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the redirect belongs to.

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Domain the redirect listens on. Exactly one of resource_id and domain_id must be set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is active. Defaults to true.
- `match_path` (String) Path to match. Omit to match every path.
- `path_match_type` (String) How match_path is compared to the request path: exact, prefix or regex. Defaults to regex.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Send a permanent redirect instead of a temporary one. Requires Badger 1.8.0 or later. Defaults to false.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation order, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100, which lets Pangolin order the redirect.
- `resource_id` (Number) Resource whose domain the redirect applies to. Exactly one of resource_id and domain_id must be set.
- `rewrite_path` (String) Path to send to the destination. Required when rewrite_path_type is exact, prefix or regex. Omit to keep the original path.
- `rewrite_path_type` (String) How rewrite_path is applied: exact, prefix, regex or stripPrefix. stripPrefix removes the matched prefix and takes no rewrite_path.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Serve the redirect's domain over TLS. Can only be turned off with domain_id; redirects on a resource follow the resource's ssl setting. Defaults to true.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain under domain_id. Omit to redirect the domain itself. Only valid with domain_id.

### Read-Only

- `nice_id` (String) Human-readable ID, unique per org.
- `redirect_id` (Number) Pangolin-assigned redirect ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_redirect.example acme:5
```
